story: Straight from the gun a 3 rider breakaway formed which managed to gain a maximum advantage of around 1 minute on the peloton. After the hilly opening part of the stage Bardiani started to bring the gap down in order to reel them in before the intermediate sprint. The break was caught with 50 KM to go after which a new strong 5 rider group got up the road. Dylan Hopkins was the last rider from this break to be caught within the final KM. Alexander Salby timed his sprint perfectly and managed to take the win in Sanya for the 2nd year in a row!
